description: Accuracy with DQuLearn (Sec. IV-B; claim accuracy-parity): QuClassi single layer, 5 qubits (4 PCA features), DQuLearn's Algorithm 1 settings (simultaneous update, shift pi/2, weights in [0, pi]), trained through the co-Manager on 2 workers with exact probabilities, 25 epochs (QuClassi). Learning rate chosen on the validation split among 1e-4, 1e-3, 1e-2 (sweep --lr). Sweep --pair and --seed.
